exposure: ketamine with bupivacaine for local wound infiltration
dexmedetomidine with bupivacaine for local wound infiltration
cohort: The study included 142 patients undergoing cesarean section.
finding: Dexmedetomidine with bupivacaine for local wound infiltration provided better quality and a longer duration of analgesia compared to ketamine with bupivacaine after cesarean section.
mod_finding: Dexmedetomidine as an adjuvant for local wound infiltration significantly improved post-cesarean section pain relief compared to ketamine.
followup_time: Up to 15.49 hours after cesarean section
